name: WayPointo
subcategory: AI and creative products directory with side-by-side comparison
tagline: A high-signal directory for AI and creative products: submit yours, compare alternatives, decide faster.

pricing.notes: No public pricing page found at review time; browsing, submitting and comparing listings is free on the site.

verdictSummary: A personal version is very buildable: a table of products with names, URLs, categories, tags and a comparison view is a weekend of CRUD around a database. What a weekend build will not have is the curated corpus - listings that were actually reviewed for signal, alternatives pages that cross-link products, and a steady stream of new submissions that keeps the directory alive. The comparison workflow itself is the part you can vibecode; the editorial layer is the part that makes people trust it.
coreLoopDIY: Store a hand-curated list of AI products with category, tags, description and URL, and render a filterable, sortable comparison dashboard.
requirements: A datastore for entries: SQLite or JSON files are plenty
Product metadata per entry: name, URL, short description, category, tags, icon
Hosting if you want it public: any static or serverless target
whatYouLose: Curated, reviewed listings - your build only knows the products you thought to add
Cross-product comparison and alternatives pages that are maintained over time
An active submission pipeline bringing in new products you did not go looking for
Editorial freshness: prices, categories and tools change faster than a personal clone gets updated
moatNotes: The listings are public information individually; the moat is the curated corpus plus the ongoing editorial work of keeping it high-signal.
notes: Directory quality lives and dies on curation and freshness, not features.
prompt:
Build me a personal AI products directory with comparison: a self-hosted web app where I collect, categorize and compare AI and creative tools.

Stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Jinja2 templates, plain CSS, SQLite via sqlite3 stdlib.

Data model:
- products(id, name, url, domain, tagline, description, category, tags, icon_url, price_model, lowest_price, added_at, updated_at)
- categories(slug, label)

Features:
- Add/edit products through a small admin form (name, URL auto-fills domain, fetch favicon, category, tags, one-line tagline)
- Directory listing with filter by category and free-text search over name/tagline/description
- Compare view: pick 2-4 products and see their fields side by side in a table
- Product detail page with description, tags, similar products in the same category
- Export/import the whole dataset as JSON so the data stays mine

Out of scope: user accounts, submissions from other people, payments, analytics.

Ship a README with setup steps and seed the database with 20 real AI products I add by hand.
